scenario_language.description: Normalized oracle scenarios, not schema-valid product records. Materialize full records through an independently reviewed fixture adapter. Dotted input keys override baseline properties; variants are separate independent runs. O22-O28 are standalone fixtures, except O26 predicate context inherits the baseline.

precedence: invalid config/record, runner or report error exit 3
demonstrated required violation or unresolved blocking defect: REJECTED exit 1
otherwise finalised valid accepted policy: ACCEPTED exit 0
module_rules: PASSED requires completed execution, nonempty criteria, all satisfied, valid artifacts, no unresolved blocker.
timed_out plus demonstrated violation is FAILED; timed_out plus unknown is REQUIRES_REVIEW.
not_run maps to NOT_RUN; blocked maps to BLOCKED; error maps to REQUIRES_REVIEW.
NOT_APPLICABLE belongs only to a justified nonrequired capability disposition.
capability_rules: Any failed module makes the selected capability FAILED.
All selected modules passed permits PASSED.
Otherwise all unresolved modules blocked gives BLOCKED; all unrun gives NOT_RUN; mixed unresolved states give REQUIRES_REVIEW.
A selected capability with zero substantive modules requires review.
normative_acceptance.completion: Only accepted finalised evidence bound to the current final candidate and adopted workflow supports verified completion.

held_out_handling.distribution: Reviewer-only answers. Exclude these cases and answers from coding/test-construction prompts and target workspaces. Give requirements only; fresh evaluator uses this packet after artifact freeze.
held_out_handling.actual_secrecy: Not enforced by a shared repository or this label. Parent can inspect all content. Any later coding agent exposed to the whole packet contaminates this held-out set; record exposure and obtain fresh unseen cases instead.
held_out_handling.scope: Useful finite reserved checks, not statistical evidence of reliability.

future_tests.materialization: Build paired real projects and evidence records; assert literal expected values/outcomes above. Gate tables alone cannot qualify process, adapter, browser or agent behavior.
future_tests.discrimination: Run each defective and healthy pair. Retain failures and raw receipts; no retry-until-pass or oracle replacement.
future_tests.scientific_limits: These deterministic toy fixtures verify units, transfer equations and convergence discrimination. They do not validate an empirical model or provide stochastic, ML leakage, operational, or all-43 adapter coverage.

ambiguities_and_assumptions.resolution: Malformed or internally contradictory records are invalid/exit 3. Valid receipts honestly recording wrong actual imports, stale observations or incomplete scope remain required gaps/exit 2. Implementers must document this boundary consistently.

Exit 130 and retention of demonstrated failures are explicit. The documents do not uniquely require REJECTED versus NOT_EVALUATED on a non-final cancelled record; O08 therefore does not fix that enum.
O26 permits strict input rejection before evaluation; a boolean cannot equal numeric one under like-scalar-type comparison.

Contract requires invalidated evidence and visible unauthorized effect but does not uniquely prescribe exit 2 versus runner error exit 3. O20 fixes the mandatory effects rather than inventing an exit.
